unsupported.platforms: Windows arm64, Linux arm64, Linux musl/Alpine, macOS amd64 and any other OS/CPU pair are not built, packaged or tested by this release line. The mod itself is Java and platform-independent as long as Minecraft runs.
unsupported.proxy: Only byte-transparent TCP relaying is within the tested boundary. The control transport is a TLS connection accepted on the same port as the game listener; a proxy that forwards the raw byte stream does not need to understand Minecraft or the control protocol. Minecraft-aware or TLS-terminating proxies were not tested and are not claimed: a proxy that inspects, rewrites or terminates the Minecraft/TLS stream can break the certificate pin and the connection classification.
unsupported.daemonPlacement: Remote means a control address reachable over TCP. The daemon host never interprets a remote server's world path as a local path; snapshot/fork/restore stay on the game host path.
